However, here’s a quick guide to finding the newest releases—and a few high‑profile films that were slated for late 2025/early 2026 based on industry announcements: | Platform | How to Find New Releases | |----------|---------------------------| | **Cinema** | Check your local theater chain’s website (AMC, Regal, Cinemark) – most chains publish weekly “Now Showing” pages.
Use apps like Fandango or Flixster to see showtimes and read reviews. | | **Streaming Services** | • **Netflix:** Browse the “New & Popular” section or use the “Release Calendar.”
• **Disney+:** Look at the “Upcoming” tab for next month’s slate.
• **Amazon Prime Video / Hulu / Apple TV+ / Peacock:** Each has a dedicated “Coming Soon” page. | | **Film Festivals** | Keep tabs on Sundance, Cannes, Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF), SXSW, and others—premieres there often become theatrical releases shortly after. | | **Industry News Sites** | Variety, Deadline Hollywood, IndieWire, Screen Daily, and The Hollywood Reporter regularly post release schedules. | | **Aggregators** | IMDb’s “Movies Coming Soon,” Rotten Tomatoes’ “Upcoming Movies,” and Letterboxd’s “Soon To Be Released” sections compile worldwide releases. | ### Notable Titles Expected Around Late 2025/Early 2026 *(These were announced before my last update in early 2026; actual release dates may shift.)* | Title | Studio | Release Window | Notes | |-------|--------|---------------|-------| | **“Avatar III”** | 20th Century Studios / James Cameron | Summer 2026 | Third installment in the Avatar franchise; expected to hit both IMAX and home‑video markets. | | **“Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 5”** | Marvel Studios | Spring 2026 | Part of Phase 7; likely to premiere in theatres followed by Disney+. | | **“Mission: Impossible 9”** | Paramount Pictures | Fall 2026 | Tom Cruise returns;
